title: 第15章 收小魔星江小鱼第16章 亲上加亲
lines: “当然知道，最近半月谈很火的‘狂士’江寒。”
“那你可知道我的规矩。”江寒继续，一步步引诱小鱼儿。
小鱼儿聪明伶俐，鬼点子多，俨然就是男版年轻时候的黄蓉。
“不知道。”
“想知道问题的答案，只需要拜我为师，我当即为你解答。”
剩下解释的事情，自然就交给双龙。
只收孤儿的门派，拜师后就能知晓自己的身世，也能知道自己所担心的事情。
即便是聪明机灵的小鱼儿，在涉及到自己身世以及燕伯伯后，也罕见的陷入了深思和沉默。
反倒是一旁完全当乐子人凑热闹的韦小宝，嚷嚷着想要拜师。
韦小宝从小就在扬州城生活。
不过老妈韦春花是个烟花青楼接客的人，所以韦小宝从小便学会了插科打诨，见人说人话，见鬼说鬼话。
“师父，你就收下我吧。虽然我妈还健在，但我从没见过老爸，也算是半个孤儿，也符合要求的！”
江寒无视了一旁叽叽喳喳的韦小宝，目光紧盯着小鱼儿。
相较于韦小宝，小鱼儿这种一下就能拜师成功的，更能引起他的兴趣。
“想好了吗？”
小鱼儿考虑片刻，却没直接应下，只是说道：“要想好的可不是我，不就是拜师吗，我都有十位师父了，自然也不嫌多这一位。但是你可要想清楚，可是有一个惹不起的大势力一直在追杀我。”
“要是收了我，那就是和这个大势力为敌，到时候压力可大得很。”
江寒笑了笑，如此粗糙的激将法。
看来是时候得让现在的孩子们认识到什么叫杀人诛心了。
江寒一副无所谓的语气：“不就是移花宫么，怎么，被花无缺追杀了几次，已经吓得连名字都不敢说了吗？”
然而江寒的“针对”还没停，把目光转向韦小宝，问道：“小宝，要是有个男人被人追杀，结果要靠心爱的女人脱光了衣服乞求才侥幸活了一命，你觉得咋样？”
韦小宝直接捂着脸，语气更是惊讶到提高了三度。
“这还算男人吗？要是换做我，肯定羞愧到自杀。”
就连双龙也拳头攥紧，有代入感了。
“我宁愿自杀，也肯定不会让心爱的女人脱下衣衫的。”
“靠女人的身体蒙阴苟活，枉为人！”
三人说完，却发现小鱼儿低着头，浑身憋着一股劲。
一个荒唐的想法从三人脑海中生出，师父说的那个需要女人庇护的人，该不会就是小鱼儿吧？
几人的话，像是一柄柄钢刀，刺入小鱼儿的心脏，让他无法呼吸。
“有些人啊，自诩天下第一等的聪明人。可这聪明人，却完全是个大蠢蛋！脑袋和计谋可以解决很多问题不假，但是在绝对的力量面前，一切的把戏都是纸老虎。”
“好，我拜师！”
小鱼儿当即跪倒在地。
就江寒刚才展现出来的实力，除了尚未苏醒的燕伯伯外，是他见过实力最强的一人。
content_en:
"Of course I know about the 'crazy man' Jiang Han who has been very popular in the past half month."
"Then you know my rules." Jiang Han continued, seducing Xiao Yu'er step by step.
Xiao Yu'er is smart and full of clever ideas. He is just like the male version of Huang Rong when he was young.
"I don't know."
"If you want to know the answer to your question, just worship me as your teacher and I will answer it for you right away."
The rest of the explanation was naturally left to Ssangyong.
A sect that only accepts orphans. After becoming a disciple, you can know your own life experience and what you are worried about.
Even the smart and clever Xiao Yu'er rarely fell into deep thought and silence when it came to his own life experience and Uncle Yan.
On the contrary, Wei Xiaobao, who was just enjoying the fun, was clamoring to become a disciple.
Wei Xiaobao has lived in Yangzhou City since he was a child.
However, his mother, Wei Chunhua, was a receptionist at a brothel, so Wei Xiaobao learned to make jokes from an early age, talking to people and talking to ghosts.
"Master, just accept me. Although my mother is still alive, I have never met my father. I am considered a half-orphan, so I meet the requirements!"
Jiang Han ignored Wei Xiaobao who was chirping at the side and stared at Xiao Yu'er.
Compared to Wei Xiaobao, Xiao Yuer, who could become a disciple immediately, was more interesting to him.
"Have you thought about it?"
Xiao Yu'er thought about it for a moment, but did not directly agree. He just said: "It's not me who wants to think about it, but it's all about becoming a master. I already have ten masters, so naturally I don't want this one too many. But you have to think clearly, but there is a big force that you can't afford to offend that has been chasing me."
"If you accept me, you will become an enemy of this big force. Then the pressure will be very high."
Jiang Han smiled, such a rough provocation.
It seems that it is time for today's children to realize what it means to kill someone and kill the heart.
Jiang Han said in an indifferent tone: "Isn't it Yihua Palace? Why, after being chased by Hua Wuque several times, are you so scared that you don't even dare to say your name?"
However, Jiang Han's "targeting" hadn't stopped yet. He turned his attention to Wei Xiaobao and asked, "Xiaobao, if a man was hunted down and killed, and his beloved woman took off her clothes and begged to survive, what would you think?"
Wei Xiaobao directly covered his face, and his tone of voice was even more surprised and raised three times.
"Is this still a man? If it were me, I would be so ashamed that I would commit suicide."
Even Ssangyong clenched his fists and felt a sense of involvement.
"I would rather commit suicide than let the woman I love take off her clothes."
"It's a waste of time to live on a woman's body!"
After the three of them finished speaking, they found that Xiao Yu'er lowered his head and was filled with energy.
A ridiculous idea came to the minds of the three of them. Could it be that the person the master mentioned who needed a woman's protection was Xiao Yu'er?
The words of several people were like steel knives piercing Xiao Yu'er's heart, making him unable to breathe.
"Some people claim to be the most intelligent people in the world. But this intelligent person is actually a big fool! It is true that brains and strategies can solve many problems, but in the face of absolute power, all tricks are just paper tigers."
"Okay, I'll become my apprentice!"
Xiao Yu'er immediately fell to his knees.
Regarding the strength Jiang Han showed just now, except for Uncle Yan who has not yet awakened, he is the strongest person he has ever seen.
title_en: Chapter 15 Accepting the Little Demon Star Jiang Xiaoyu Chapter 16 Kissing and Kissing
